title: The Ark Brought to the Temple

questions.question: What did Solomon bring in once the work was finished?
options: The things that David his father had dedicated
questions.correctAnswer: The things that David his father had dedicated
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:1 (ESV): "...Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated..."

questions.question: Who assembled in Jerusalem to bring up the ark?
options: The elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes
questions.correctAnswer: The elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:2 (ESV): "Then Solomon assembled the elders of Israel and all the heads of the tribes..."

questions.question: Where was the ark brought from?
options: The city of David, which is Zion
questions.correctAnswer: The city of David, which is Zion
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:2 (ESV): "...out of the city of David, which is Zion."

questions.question: Who took up the ark?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:4 (ESV): "...and the Levites took up the ark."

questions.question: What did they sacrifice before the ark?
options: Sheep and oxen that could not be numbered
questions.correctAnswer: Sheep and oxen that could not be numbered
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:6 (ESV): "...sacrificing so many sheep and oxen that they could not be counted or numbered."

questions.question: Where precisely did the priests bring the ark?
options: To its place in the inner sanctuary of the house, in the Most Holy Place
questions.correctAnswer: To its place in the inner sanctuary of the house, in the Most Holy Place
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:7 (ESV): "...to its place, in the inner sanctuary of the house, in the Most Holy Place..."

questions.question: What covered the ark and its poles?
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:8 (ESV): "...the cherubim covered the ark and its poles overhead."

questions.question: What was inside the ark?
options: Nothing but the two tablets that Moses put there at Horeb
Aaron's rod and manna and tablets
questions.correctAnswer: Nothing but the two tablets that Moses put there at Horeb
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:10 (ESV): "There was nothing in the ark except the two tablets that Moses put there at Horeb..."

questions.question: When did the cloud fill the house of the LORD?
options: When the song was raised with trumpets and cymbals offering praise
questions.correctAnswer: When the song was raised with trumpets and cymbals offering praise
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:13 (ESV): "...and when the song was raised... the house... was filled with a cloud..."

questions.question: Why could the priests not stand to minister?
options: Because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house
questions.correctAnswer: Because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:14 (ESV): "...so that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of God."

questions.question: During which feast did this assembly happen?
options: The feast in the seventh month
questions.correctAnswer: The feast in the seventh month
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:3 (ESV): "...at the feast that is in the seventh month."

questions.question: From where were the poles of the ark visible?
options: From the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from the outside
questions.correctAnswer: From the Holy Place in front of the inner sanctuary, but not from the outside
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:9 (ESV): "The poles were so long that the ends of the poles were seen from the Holy Place... but they could not be seen from outside."

questions.question: Who were the Levitical singers standing east of the altar?
options: Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, their sons and kinsmen
questions.correctAnswer: Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, their sons and kinsmen
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:12 (ESV): "and all the Levitical singers, Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun, their sons and kinsmen..."

questions.question: How many priests blew the trumpets?
What was the refrain of their praise?
options: For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever
questions.correctAnswer: For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever
questions.explanation: 2 Chronicles 5:13 (ESV): "...For he is good, for his steadfast love endures forever..."

key_verse_text: So that the priests could not stand to minister because of the cloud, for the glory of the LORD filled the house of God.
